node.name: service
node.description: the local Vite dev servers for the rules, tools, and play apps in this checkout.
node.whenToUse: you need one of the Heart Rush sites running locally, need to know whether it is up, or need its logs.
node.summary: the local Vite dev servers for the rules, tools, and play apps in this checkout
node.model: Three processes, one per app: `vite dev` in apps/<app> on this checkout's port for that app (source: rules 3910, tools 3911, play 3912; a Grove instance adds slot * 100). Each runs the app's Worker locally through the Cloudflare Vite plugin. Every leaf takes --app to act on one app; the default is all three. Northlight sign-in only works on the source ports, because only localhost:3911 and :3912 are registered redirect URIs.

children.name: status
children.description: report whether this checkout's dev servers are running.
children.whenToUse: before starting, testing against, or debugging a local site.
children.summary: report whether this checkout's dev servers are running

params.name: app
params.constraint: Which app to act on: rules, tools, play, or all three.

output.name: state
output.constraint: running, starting, stopped, or foreign (port held by a process this checkout did not start) when every selected app agrees; mixed otherwise.

output.name: apps
output.constraint: One entry per selected app: { app, state, port, url, pid, detail }. port is 3910/3911/3912 (rules/tools/play) in the source and base + slot * 100 in a Grove instance; running means /health answered with this app's name.

output.name: detail
output.constraint: One line summarizing each app's state.

children.name: logs
children.description: read recent output from one app's dev server.
children.whenToUse: a page errors, a server will not start, or you need build or request output.
children.summary: read recent output from one app's dev server

params.name: app
params.constraint: Which app's log to read: rules, tools, or play.

params.name: tail
params.constraint: Number of most recent lines to return. Must be >= 1.

output.name: path
output.constraint: Absolute path of the log file.
